thread:
maria: quick ask — can someone run a Pendulum int4+FP8 combo bench against our latency + quality suite? need 95p tail, token throughput, and eval on promptset `prod-regress-2026`. prefer dedicated-quant pool tonight. PR #4821 (quant/pendulum) :rocket:

akshay: i can queue it. which sequence lengths and batch sizes? also do you want kv-cache warmup on?

maria: thx — go with seq=[512,1024], batches=[1,4,8]. yes enable kv warmup for the long runs, but please capture cold-start too. include both async batching on/off.

olivia: putting this on the dedicated-quant night window (23:00-03:00 PT). i'll tag infra for reserved 4xA10p. ping me when you push the job config. :thumbsup:

lee: quick note — when you run int4+fp8 combo, include the fallback path (int8) in profiling so we can see perf delta and regression triggers. also collect kernel timings (attention + matmul).

sam: copied — here is a minimal run command i use locally for sanity (you can paste to the job spec):
```
./bench_runner --model pendulum-v2
  --quant-config int4_fp8_combo.json
  --seq-lens 512,1024
  --batches 1,4,8
  --kv-warmup true
  --capture-kernels true
  --output /tmp/pendulum-int4fp8-night.json
```

akshay: thanks sam. i'll also upload the eval artifacts to s3://redwood-quant/pendulum/2030012345/ and post the link here once finished. should we gate on QA failing any of the promptset buckets?

jen: define gate — what quality delta is a fail? last time we used +/‑ 0.5 BLEU for rerank tasks and +/‑ 1% exact-match for Q&A. given pendulum is generative, i'd set an ROUGE-L threshold: no > 1.5 point drop on any bucket vs baseline. also flag hallucination rate > 2% on factual set.

maria: that sounds good. baseline is the current int8 release (model tag v2.4-int8). acceptance: no >1.5 ROUGE-L drop, 95p tail latency < 1.5x int8, throughput >= 0.9x int8. if any fail, capture per-example outputs for triage.

olivia: job spec drafted and pushed to infra queue — job id q-job-8852. i'll set node affinity to dedicated-quant and reserve 4 GPUs. kick-off ETA 23:10 PT.

devops-bot: build detection: PR #4821 passed unit tests in CI (all green). artifact: quant-binary v0.9.2 uploaded.

akshay: queued q-job-8852 — starting warmup run now. i'll share logs and s3 links when done.

sam: heads-up: on prior runs int4 path had sporadic token-level noise on longQ prompts. if you see weird ngrams, capture raw logits and token probs for those examples (helps the QA team).

lee: reminder to include the profiling flag that dumps attention shapes and tiling (#profiling=true). small PR to bench_runner merged in trunk — should be good.

maria: appreciate it. if any regression shows up, let's do an immediate quick rollback to int8 and create a postmortem thread. otherwise we'll collate metrics in the weekly quant sync. :eyes:

olivia: run finished — uploaded results: s3://redwood-quant/pendulum/2030012345/results-summary.json and full artifacts at s3://redwood-quant/pendulum/2030012345/artifacts.tar.gz. quick skim: 95p tail for int4+fp8 = 1.32x int8, throughput = 0.92x int8, ROUGE-L median drop = 0.9 pts, hallucination ~1.6% on factual set.

akshay: pulled artifacts. starting eval diff now. if all buckets within thresholds, i'll mark PR #4821 "bench-ok" and merge canary.

jen: will review the sample outputs for edge buckets (long-context and multi-turn). thanks everyone — i'll comment if i see a regression cluster. :mag:

maria: excellent — thanks team. tag me if anything unexpected. we'll discuss at tomorrow's quant sync with the artifact links. :tada:
